maddeler.e:
يحتشم (form VIII)
# يَحْتَشِمُ (yaḥtašimu) /jaħ.ta.ʃi.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَشَمَ (iḥtašama)
# يَحْتَشِمَ (yaḥtašima) /jaħ.ta.ʃi.ma/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَشَمَ (iḥtašama)
# يَحْتَشِمْ (yaḥtašim) /jaħ.ta.ʃim/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِحْتَشَمَ (iḥtašama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
